claims.title: Constructive commuting thermal initialization and calibrated terminal-noise loading

quoted_fields.interface: The two received packages have qualified internal reviews of an actual-code decoder-trace representation, an ideal commuting Gibbs-syndrome sampler using established polymer machinery, and a positive pre-distorted sampler/logical lift through sufficiently small known independent terminal Pauli noise. Separate coherent-access, weighted-admission and operator-positivity results expose the remaining generic physical preparation gap.
quoted_fields.failure: Actual INTERNAL qualified acceptances cover a known COMMUTING recursive-code ideal initializer and a calibrated INDEPENDENT TERMINAL-Pauli loader for a SUPPLIED encoded input, plus narrower access/positivity lemmas. Low fixed temperature, matched actual decoder, tiny calibrated noise, enormous constants and real bit/control/routing/reset/entropy costs remain binding. No generic coherent/correlated/noise-during-preparation theorem, actual interacting spin-bath Gibbs preparation, noisy input/access threshold or practical memory. Positive quantum preimage is not efficient preparation. Earlier disorder-3D ZIP stays UNCONFIRMED/NO RETRY and its whole memory review/check claims are not recovered here. No Capital reproof/replay/new signoff.
